about: DESIGN 5.1 site checklist (checklist.lua). World tiles, Chebyshev distance. old_sites are Gordon's earlier forts (his own history). dark_fortresses_seen is filled from the vanilla world map (dark fortress icons) or left empty; then the panel's Neighbors section and the 'invaded very early' popup are the only evidence; without them the criterion stays 'unknown' (verdict review; embark only with --waive dark_fortress).
old_site_note: L0 2026-10-10 (world Zilirreth/region2, 33x33): with old_site_min 10 the only tiles left (y>=24, or x<=5 with y>=20) were all hot/scorching, light/heavy aquifer and within 1/2 day of goblin sites or on a site ('Cannot embark'); about 90 rectangles scanned. 4 keeps the fort out of every old fort's tile and its 3 neighbours; goblin distance is judged from the Neighbors section (dark_fortress).
